officialTitle: Phase III study of pemetrexed in combination with cisplatin versus cisplatin alone in patients with malignant pleural mesothelioma

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: A total of 456 patients were assigned: 226 received pemetrexed and cisplatin, 222 received cisplatin alone, and eight never received therapy.
design.notes: Chemotherapy-naive patients not eligible for curative surgery. Folic acid and vitamin B12 supplementation was added after 117 patients had enrolled to reduce toxicity.

clinicalQuestion: Does pemetrexed plus cisplatin improve survival over cisplatin alone in chemotherapy-naive malignant pleural mesothelioma?

pico.population: Chemotherapy-naive malignant pleural mesothelioma not eligible for curative surgery
pico.intervention: Pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 plus cisplatin 75 mg/m2 every 21 days
pico.outcomes: Primary: OS. Secondary: time to progression, response rate, toxicity

arms.label: Pemetrexed + cisplatin
arms.regimen: Pemetrexed + cisplatin (with folic acid and vitamin B12 after protocol amendment)
arms.dosing: Pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 and cisplatin 75 mg/m2 IV day 1 every 21 days
arms.doseSourceQuote: Chemotherapy-naive patients who were not eligible for curative surgery were randomly assigned to receive pemetrexed 500 mg/m2 and cisplatin 75 mg/m2 on day 1, or cisplatin 75 mg/m2 on day 1. Both regimens were given intravenously every 21 days.

arms.label: Cisplatin
arms.dosing: Cisplatin 75 mg/m2 IV day 1 every 21 days
arms.doseSourceQuote: or cisplatin 75 mg/m2 on day 1. Both regimens were given intravenously every 21 days.

publications.title: Phase III study of pemetrexed in combination with cisplatin versus cisplatin alone in patients with malignant pleural mesothelioma.
publications.label: Primary analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: Median survival time in the pemetrexed/cisplatin arm was 12.1 months versus 9.3 months in the control arm (P =.020, two-sided log-rank test). The hazard ratio for death of patients in the pemetrexed/cisplatin arm versus those in the control arm was 0.77.
Median time to progression was significantly longer in the pemetrexed/cisplatin arm: 5.7 months versus 3.9 months (P =.001).
Response rates were 41.3% in the pemetrexed/cisplatin arm versus 16.7% in the control arm (P <.0001).

safety.description: Vitamin supplementation (folic acid and B12) added after protocol amendment significantly reduced toxicity of pemetrexed/cisplatin (no rates in abstract)
safety.sourceQuote: After 117 patients had enrolled, folic acid and vitamin B12 were added to reduce toxicity, resulting in a significant reduction in toxicities in the pemetrexed/cisplatin arm.

strengths: Consistent benefit across OS, time to progression and response
limitations: Control arm of cisplatin alone is no longer a relevant comparator
Hazard ratio reported without confidence interval in the abstract

clinicalImplications.text: Established pemetrexed plus cisplatin with folic acid and vitamin B12 supplementation as the chemotherapy backbone for unresectable pleural mesothelioma.

tumourBoardPearl.text: Vitamin supplementation is integral to pemetrexed: it was introduced in this trial because it reduced toxicity without compromising survival.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 12860938. No CI for the OS hazard ratio and no registry ID printed in the abstract.
